Description.TranslatedText: Last injection date AENDT-First injection date ASTDT+7, by USUBJID. If a participant dies less than seven days after the last injection, then Death date-First injection date ASTDT+1.
For PARAMCD="EXDOSE", Set to the numeric date part of EC.ECENDTC. For other parameters (ADURD, NUMINJ, NUMINJM, PERCOMP), Set to the numeric date part of the last EC.ECENDTC.
For PARAMCD = 'EXDOSE', Set to Date and time part of EC.ECENDTC, converted to SAS date/time using datetime20. format, Else for all other parameters set to missing.
If AENDT and ADSL.TRTSDT is not missing then AENDT - ADSL.TRTSDT. If value >=0 then add 1.
For PARAMCD = 'EXDOSE' Set to Time part of EC.ECENDTC, converted using ISO format, Else for all other parameters set to missing
If AESTDT and ADSL.TRTSDT is not missing then AESTDT - ADSL.TRTSDT. If value >=0 then add 1.
For PARAMCD="EXDOSE", Set to the numeric date part of EC.ECSTDTC. For other parameters (ADURD, NUMINJ, NUMINJM, PERCOMP), set to the numeric date part of the first EC.ECSTDTC.
For PARAMCD = 'EXDOSE' set to Date and time part of EC.ECSTDTC, converted to SAS date/time using datetime20. format Else for all other parameters, set to missing
For PARAMCD = 'EXDOSE' Set to Time part of EC.ECSTDTC, converted using ISO format Else for all other parameters, set to missing

If 1<=AVAL/7<=12 then avalcat1 = "1-12 weeks", else if 13<=AVAL/7<=26 then avalcat1 = "13-26 weeks", else if 27<=AVAL/7<=40 then avalcat1 = "27-40 weeks", else if 41<=AVAL/7<=52 then avalcat1 = "41-52 weeks", else if AVAL/7 is > 52 then avalcat1 = "> 52 weeks"

If 1<=AVAL<=12 then avalcat1 = "1-12 doses", else if 13<=AVAL<=26 then avalcat1 = "13-26 doses", else if 27<=AVAL<=40 then avalcat1 = "27-40 doses", else if 41<=AVAL<=52 then avalcat1 = "41-52 doses", else if AVAL is > 52 then avalcat1 = ">52 doses"

If AVAL = 0 then avalcat1 = "0 missed doses", else if AVAL =1 then avalcat1 = "1 missed dose", else if AVAL = 2 then avalcat1 = "2 missed doses", else if AVAL = 3 then avalcat1 = "3 missed doses ", else if aval is > 3 then avalcat1 = ">3 missed doses"
If AVAL is less than 80% then avalcat1 = "< 80%", else if AVAL is greater or equal to 80% then avalcat1 = ">= 80%"

Injections occur weekly. The Baseline injection is on day 1, with no window. The Week 1 injection is on day 8 with a -3, +3 day window. Each subsequent weekly visit is +7 days with a +/- 3 day window labeled Week x.
Set to EC.ECDOSE when ECOCCUR = "Y", Not include when ECOCCUR = "N". when a dose is administered on same day but on different timings, include the earliest date record.
Count distinct ASTDT for PARAMCD="EXDOSE", by USUBJID when EC.ECOCCUR = "Y"

For completed or treatment discontinued subjects, Expected injections received - injections received, by USUBJID. Injections received is AVAL where PARAMCD=NUMINJ. Expected injections received is 52 or an adjusted number based on study treatment discontinuation (ex. treatment discontinuation after week 48 would result in week 49-week 51 injections being excluded so adjusted value is 49) and The window for exposure is (X x 7)-2 to (X x 7)+4 where X is the week of the dose and the result is the number of days since first dose. If the treatment discontinuation date is after (X x 7)+4 (i.e. outside the +/-3 day window in the SoA), then consider the dose as missed. If the treatment discontinuation date is on or before (X x 7)+4 (i.e. inside the +/- 3 day window in the SoA), then do not consider the dose a missed dose. For ongoing subjects: Identify the last visit, Expected injections would be last visit +1 (Baseline) - number of injections received (AVAL where PARAMCD = NUMINJ), by USUBJID. Populate 0 when there are no missed injections
Calculate as follows: (AVAL where PARAMCD=NUMINJ/ (AVAL where PARAMCD=NUMINJ+AVAL where PARAMCD=NUMINJM))*100, by USUBJID.

Calculated age in years (taking into account leap years) at randomization date. Programmatically: intck("year", BRTHDT, RANDDT) - (month(RANDDT) < month(BRTHDT) or (month(RANDDT) = month(BRTHDT) and day(RANDDT) < day(BRTHDT))).
if ADSL.AAGE <= 45 then ADSL.AGEGR1 = "<= 45 years"; else if ADSL.AAGE > 45 and ADSL.AAGE < 65 then ADSL.AGEGR1 = "> 45 - < 65 years"; else if ADSL.AAGE >= 65 then ADSL.AGEGR1 = ">= 65 years";
if ADSL.AAGE is >= 65 and ADSL.AAGE < 75 then ADSL.AGEGR2 = ">= 65 - < 75 years"; else if ADSL.AAGE is >= 75 then ADSL.AGEGR2 = ">= 75 years";
ADSL.WEIGHTBL / [(ADSL.HEIGHTBL/100)**2]. Value is rounded to 1 decimal place.
Set to YEAR part of DM.BRTHDTC with the day and month imputed as "30JUN".
Set to "M" if ADSL.BRTHDT is present
Set to "Y" if DS.DSDECOD eq "ENTERED INTO TRIAL" and not missing(DS.DSSTDTC); Else "N"
Set to "Y" if ADSL.RANDFL = "Y" and there exists a record in EX.EXSTDTC and not missing EXDOSE. Else "N".
Set to VS.VSSTRESN for the latest pre-dose assessment where VS.VSTESTCD = "HEIGHT".

Set to "Y" if the subject entered the Open Label Extension study, i.e. a record exists in DS where DSTERM = "SUBJECT AGREE TO OPEN LABEL EXTENSION". Set to "N" for SCREEN FAILURE subjects or if (DS.DSSCAT="SCREENING" and latest DS.DSDECOD ne "COMPLETED") or (DS.DSSCAT="STUDY CONCLUSION" and DS.DSDECOD ne "COMPLETED") or (DS.DSTERM = "SUBJECT DID NOT AGREE TO OPEN LABEL EXTENSION"). Leave subjects who are ongoing in Study as blanks.
Set to numeric date version of DS.DSSTDTC where DS.DSDECOD = "INTERVENTION/TREATMENT ASSIGNED"
Set to "Y" if a record exists in DS where DS.DSDECOD="INTERVENTION/TREATMENT ASSIGNED"; Else "N"
Set to SUPPDS.QVAL where SUPPDS.QNAM eq "RANDNUM"
Set to "Y" if DS.DSSCAT eq "SCREENING" and not missing(DS.DSSTDTC); Else "N"

"For patients that are randomized, merge SU and SV datasets where VISIT="SCREENING". If SUSMHIS in ("Never smoked" "Former smoker") and SV.SVSTDTC and SU.SUENDTC are not missing then TOBDURS = round((SVSTDTC - SUENDTC + 1 )/ 365.25, .1); If SUSMHIS="Current smoker" and SV.SVSTDTC and SU.SUSTDTC are not missing then TOBDURS = round((SVSTDTC - SUSTDTC + 1 )/ 365.25, .1)

For patients that are randomized, set SUSMHIS = "Never smoked" if SUPPSU.QNAM = "SUNCF" and SUPPSU.QVAL = "NEVER"; else set SUSMHIS = "Current smoker" if SUPPSU.QNAM = "SUNCF" and SUPPSU.QVAL = "CURRENT"; else set SUSMHIS = "Former Smoker" if SUPPSU.QNAM = "SUNCF" and SUPPSU.QVAL = "FORMER"; else set SUSMHIS = "Unknown" if no information is available in SU.
if DM.ACTARM is missing and upcase(DM.ARMNRS ) in ("SCREEN FAILURE" "NOT ASSIGNED" "ASSIGNED, NOT TREATED") then TRT01A = "No Treatment"; else TRT01A=DM.ACTARM
if DM.ARM is missing and upcase(DM.ARMNRS) in ("SCREEN FAILURE" "NOT ASSIGNED") then TRT01P = "No Treatment"; else TRT01P=DM.ARM
